9.7.13.2. Control Flow Instructions: @
@
Predicated execution.
@{!}p    instruction;
Execute an instruction or instruction block for threads that have the guard predicate True. Threads with a False guard predicate do nothing.
context_before: 21822-21825: end of Examples code block of section 9.7.13.1 and </section>
reason_for_inclusion: KEY predication evidence: the general predication/control-flow section 9.7.13.2 explicitly states 'Threads with a False guard predicate do nothing.' This is the official clause that grounds the guard-false no-state-update consequence for predicated instructions; by the general predicability rule (XOR-013, XOR-018) it applies to all PTX instructions, including xor.b32.
